concept: Snow Family: offline transfer of hundreds of TB over a slow link
tests: Choosing how to move hundreds of terabytes to S3 when the internet link is too slow.
expected: AWS Snowball Edge — physical devices shipped to AWS. Triggers: "hundreds of terabytes", "internet connection is too slow", "reasonable time", one-time migration.
why_not: DataSync and multipart upload are bottlenecked by the same slow link; Direct Connect takes months to provision, overkill for a one-time transfer.
